messages:
alex_m: Heads up — we spotted a cluster-wide uptick in ECC and Xid 31 errors across us-west-gpu-pool-3. 8 cards flagged in the last 24h. Opening vendor RMA and planning depot return/kitting. Ticket VND-987654 created.

sara_infra: Thanks. Can you paste serials + asset tags? also need photos for vendor intake and confirmation of which nodes to drain.

alex_m: Serial list below, pulled from asset DB:

```
SN: RWI-AZ-9234  / asset: GPU-2043
SN: RWI-AZ-9237  / asset: GPU-2048
SN: RWI-AZ-9241  / asset: GPU-2051
SN: RWI-AZ-9245  / asset: GPU-2056
SN: RWI-AZ-9250  / asset: GPU-2062
SN: RWI-AZ-9253  / asset: GPU-2066
SN: RWI-AZ-9258  / asset: GPU-2070
SN: RWI-AZ-9260  / asset: GPU-2073
```

alex_m: Uploaded photos to the ticket and to the incident assets folder: https://redwood.internal/assets/rma/1769954321 (links internal).

dennis_ops: Spare pool check: we have 5 cold spares in us-west-2 racks, 3 hot spares in staging. If we swap 3-in-place immediately, capacity hit is ~12% for this pool during business hours. Recommend kitting 4 for depot return and staging 2 replacements for staggered drains.

jules_platform: Region routing note — if we drain more than 4 GPUs in a single AZ we'll start seeing queued jobs. Can we divert some inference traffic to us-east-dedicated for 6–12h windows? Also confirm quotas for us-east burst.

liam_oncall: I already drained node us-west-3b-rack12-node07 last night (GPU-2051). That one is offline and in the kitting queue. No customer-facing alerts yet but latency p99 bumped ~30ms for a few routes.

alex_m: Plan draft: 1) Stage 2 hot spares to affected racks tonight 22:00–00:00 PT, 2) Drain 3 additional nodes in rolling fashion (1 AZ at a time) 3) Ship 4 failed cards to depot for depot-repair RMA, 4) Keep 2 spares as swap-in for next 48h. Anyone object? :thumbsup::thumbsdown:

sara_infra: No objections. Please make sure shipping labels are printed with the correct depot address: Depot-West-3 (RMA center). I'll generate labels in rma system after confirmation.

rma-bot: [automated] Ticket VND-987654 updated: "Photos received, initial triage passed, awaiting depot acceptance. ETA for depot pickup: 3 business days. RMA type: depot-swap. RMA SLA: 14 days."

vendor_agent: Vendor update: we can accept returns at Depot-West-3. Please ensure each package includes the completed intake form (rma-form.pdf) and the flashing log segment showing ECC counts. We will issue RM-45100 once received.

dennis_ops: Agree on form. We should also include inventory checklist. I'll attach a pre-filled manifest to the ticket and coordinate pickup with Ops courier (tracking to be added).

alex_m: Courier scheduled for 1769957800 (pickup window). Labels queued. Manifest attached to VND-987654.

liam_oncall: Quick note — flagging two cards as flaky: GPU-2066 (intermittent ECC corrected by reseat) and GPU-2070 (Xid errors persist after reseat). Mark GPU-2066 as conditional return (vendor might request further repro).

jules_platform: Also: any cost implication for using depot-swap vs depot-repair? We should minimize downtime and cost — if vendor offers exchange, that's preferred.

vendor_agent: Depot-swap will be charged as pre-authorized replacement; final billing depends on vendor inspection. We'll scope once RM-45100 is processed. If cards pass inspection and failure is DOA, charges waived.

alex_m: Will track billing flags in the RMA ticket and loop finance if needed.

sara_infra: Post-action items: 1) confirm pickup + tracking 2) update spare pool counts in inventory 3) run a quick capacity shift to us-east if p99 exceeds threshold during drains. I'll own 1 and 2. Liam/jules own 3.

liam_oncall: On it. I'll set an autoscaling policy to prefer us-east burst at 50% threshold and alert if spillover > 20% for more than 10m.

alex_m: Thanks all. Will post a short status update in #incidents if pickup occurs or if vendor changes ETA. :white_check_mark:"
